sql: SELECT policy, count(*) AS quotes, count(DISTINCT market_ticker) AS mkts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ended_at IS NULL) AS resting, min(placed_at) AS first FROM incentive_shadow_quotes WHERE placed_at >= now() - interval '30 minutes' AND policy IN ('S1','S2-best','S2-behind','S3-aside','S3-control','S4-burst','S4-flat') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
